metadata.technology_specification: Automatic or Semi-automatic Capsule Filling Machine
metadata.technology_reasoning: Capsule filling machines are typically classified into automatic or semi-automatic types, with automatic machines being the industry standard for high-volume pharmaceutical and nutraceutical capsule production due to efficiency and precision. These machines predominantly fill capsules with powders, pellets, or liquids, and are widely adopted in manufacturing globally as of 2024.

components.reasoning: This subsystem loads empty capsules into the machine for filling; it is a distinct module essential for automated or semi-automated operation and separately procured in many machine designs.
Core functional component that accurately measures and dispenses powder, pellets or liquid into capsules; universally present and crucial for machine operation.
Separates capsule body and cap and then joins them post-filling; essential mechanical subsystem typically purchased as part of the machine.
Moves capsules through sequential stations; common and often modular to facilitate flow and efficiency.
Electronic control unit managing machine operation, timing, and safety; standard in modern machines and often a separate purchased component.
Mechanical power delivery system including motors and gears, critical to machine operation and typically sourced from specialized suppliers.
Removes dust from capsules before filling or after filling; common in most machines but occasionally integrated separately or omitted in simpler models.
Structural component providing support and housing for all subsystems; standard but its modularity and size vary across models.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Primary structural material for mechanical parts due to corrosion resistance and strength, standard in pharmaceutical equipment.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Aluminum
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Used for lightweight housing and some mechanical parts; common substitute for steel but less corrosion resistant.

Capsule Feeding System.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Capsule Feeding System.reasoning: Common polymer for components requiring low friction or transparency; used for feed hoppers or covers, alternatives exist.

Filling Station or Dosing System.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Filling Station or Dosing System.reasoning: Critical for all contact parts for hygiene, corrosion resistance, and durability, universally used in pharmaceutical dosing systems.

Filling Station or Dosing System.name: Aluminum
Filling Station or Dosing System.reasoning: Used in some housing parts or non-contact components; lighter than steel but less corrosion resistant.

Filling Station or Dosing System.name: PTFE coating
Filling Station or Dosing System.reasoning: Commonly applied to sliding or wear surfaces to reduce friction and prevent product sticking; essential for smooth dosing.

Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Structural and wear-resistant parts material, especially for precision moving components in contact with capsules.

Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.name: Aluminum
Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Used in housing or non-wear parts; lighter but less durable than steel.

Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.name: PTFE coating
Capsule Separation and Locking Mechanism.reasoning: Applied to sliding surfaces to minimize friction and wear for delicate capsule handling.

Conveyor or Indexing Table.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Conveyor or Indexing Table.reasoning: Primary frame, plate, and wear surface material for strength and hygiene standards.

Conveyor or Indexing Table.name: Aluminum
Conveyor or Indexing Table.reasoning: Used for lighter frame or table parts where weight reduction is beneficial.

Conveyor or Indexing Table.name: Polytetrafluoroethylene
Conveyor or Indexing Table.reasoning: Material for low friction surface coatings or sliding surfaces in conveyor systems.

Conveyor or Indexing Table.name: Polypropylene
Conveyor or Indexing Table.reasoning: Possible polymer for belts or components requiring chemical resistance and flexibility; some alternatives exist.

Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.name: Silicon
Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.reasoning: Fundamental semiconductor material for integrated circuits and microcontrollers, absolutely essential.

Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.name: Copper
Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.reasoning: Primary conductive metal for circuit traces and wiring.

Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.name: Aluminum
Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.reasoning: Used for heat sinks and some structural parts in electronic modules.

Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.name: Polycarbonate
Control System (PLC or Microcontroller-b.reasoning: Common material for control panel enclosures and protective covers, widely used but alternatives exist.

Drive System (Motors and Transmission).name: Copper
Drive System (Motors and Transmission).reasoning: Essential for motor winding coils for electrical conductivity, universally used.

Drive System (Motors and Transmission).name: Steel Ingots
Drive System (Motors and Transmission).reasoning: Base material for shafts, gears, and structural components due to strength and wear resistance.

Drive System (Motors and Transmission).name: Aluminum
Drive System (Motors and Transmission).reasoning: Used for some lightweight motor housings and gear components to reduce weight.

Drive System (Motors and Transmission).name: PTFE coating
Drive System (Motors and Transmission).reasoning: Applied for wear resistance and lubrication in moving parts; alternatives exist.

Capsule Dedusting Unit.name: Stainless steel (SS 304/316)
Capsule Dedusting Unit.reasoning: Used for frames and internal surfaces in contact with capsules for hygiene and corrosion resistance.

Capsule Dedusting Unit.name: Aluminum
Capsule Dedusting Unit.reasoning: Used in non-contact parts or housing to reduce weight.

Capsule Dedusting Unit.name: Polypropylene
Capsule Dedusting Unit.reasoning: Often used in components requiring chemical resistance and easy cleaning; alternatives exist.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Steel Ingots
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Primary material for structural frame elements providing strength and rigidity, standard industry material.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Aluminum
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Widely used for machine enclosures and panels to reduce weight while maintaining strength.

Machine Frame and Enclosure.name: Polyethylene terephthalate
Machine Frame and Enclosure.reasoning: Possible polymer for windows or protective covers but less common than glass or polycarbonate.
